messages:
Amara (People Ops): Quick kickoff here for Evergreen Spot Award (beta) 16 — lightweight $100 gift/trophy system that managers can approve without BC approval. Need volunteers for a 2-week pilot and feedback on manager playbook by EOD Tue.
Ben (People Ops): Pilot ask: 3 managers across Eng, Sales, and Prod. Will run from Mon 2/14	to Fri 2/25.
Marta (Eng): I'm in. I'll take Platform and Eng infra.
Omar (Sales): Count Sales Ops and AE team in.
Ravi (Payroll): Heads up: any award distributed outside payroll needs a vendor ID or prepaid card flow. We can do prepaid cards for small amounts but need names + emails before Friday cutoff.
Amara (People Ops): Thanks — two pilot owners confirmed. We need a 1-pager manager playbook: approval SLA (48h), allowed reasons (values-aligned bullets), frequency caps (max 2 per quarter per individual), how to handle rejections. Draft below and please comment: 
```
Manager Playbook - Evergreen Spot Award (beta)
- Purpose: Quick recognition for small moments that show Redwood values.
- Eligibility: Full-time and contractors with >90 days tenure.
- Approval: manager approves; ops audits weekly. Approval SLA = 48 hours.
- Limits: Max 2 awards per person / quarter. Ops may pause for abuse.
- Payment: <$150 = prepaid card (sent within payroll cycle). >$150 escalates to Payroll for tax review.
- Recordkeeping: All nominations in Airtable + optional anonymous note.
```

Ben (People Ops): Suggest adding an example bank of acceptable reasons and a sample email managers can cc to recipients.
Amara (People Ops): Good idea 16 I'll add 6 example bullets and a template.
Marta (Eng): Can we include a short rubric for "impact" so managers aren't guessing? like: moment (peer help / customer save / onboarding win), estimated time saved, visibility (team/all-hands).
Ben (People Ops): Love that. I'll add fields to the Airtable form: impact_type, approx_time_saved, public_flag.
Ravi (Payroll): For prepaid cards we'll need a mapping table: team -> budget_code -> approver. Ops should collect budget_code at approval time.
Amara (People Ops): We'll surface budget_code in the manager form drop-down (defaults by org). Ops will do weekly reconciliation.
Omar (Sales): Can we auto-block sales commissions if award touches commissionable activity? We should flag these to Compensation.
Amara (People Ops): Noted 16 will add comp-flag boolean and notify comp-team via webhook for flagged entries.
Ben (People Ops): Training plan: 20-min live demo for managers next Wed + short Loom + FAQ doc. Who can run demos?
Marta (Eng): I can do Wed 10am PT demo for Eng + Platform.
Omar (Sales): I can cover midday 1pm PT for Sales.
Amara (People Ops): Great. Ben and I will record Loom and draft FAQ. Also need a short managers-only Slack thread and a public announcement for #general on launch day.
lighthouse-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Evergreen Spot Award launch (beta) goes live Mon 2/14" at 9:00 AM PT.
Ravi (Payroll): One process note: for international recipients we must use local gift method or convert USD cards; payroll will handle FX but need recipient country in the form. Add country field.
Ben (People Ops): Added country field and a tooltip: "If recipient is outside US, ops will convert or use local vendor."
Marta (Eng): Pilot metrics we should capture: nominations submitted, approvals within SLA, payment time (days), recipients by org, any tax escalations.
Amara (People Ops): I'll create an Airtable view for Metrics + weekly summary email template for stakeholders.
Omar (Sales): During pilot, can ops run a quick weekly sync 15-min to surface issues?
Amara (People Ops): Yes 16 scheduling 15-min sync Fridays 9am PT. Ben will own notes.
Ben (People Ops): One last ask: privacy. If manager selects "public_flag = true" we'll post a shoutout message to #wins via webhook. Need an opt-out.
Amara (People Ops): We'll include recipient opt-out checkbox and honor it.
Ravi (Payroll): I'll test the prepaid card flow with sample test user before Friday. Tell me a test name/email and I'll confirm delivery.
Marta (Eng): Test user: "Test Recipient" test.recipient+spot@redwood.ai
Amara (People Ops): Perfect. I'll create the Airtable pilot form and post link here by EOD. Thanks everyone!
